headline: Nitco finishes Kanjurmarg land deed and gets ₹143 crore
summary: Nitco has completed the Kanjurmarg land deed transaction, bringing in a cash inflow of ₹143 crore. Such asset monetisation deals are crucial for debt-laden companies looking to clear liabilities and improve their balance sheets. For retail investors, the realization of cash from non-core assets provides short-term financial relief. However, the broader turnaround of the company depends on sustained operational execution.
why_it_matters: Cash infusion aids debt reduction for Nitco
